title: Verify European dynamic raw fragments in the production CLI
changes: Report the dynamically selected raw fragment resource identity at runtime and describe it in the extraction catalog.
validation: An isolated Windows production build and one Wine create/reuse/one-frame startup sequence pass: 85 resource identities match, all 86 generated files match the accepted e94-d93 dataset and all 88 managed files stay unchanged on reuse and startup.
The frozen source and guarded ROM, seed, native cache, accepted dataset and canonical executable remain unchanged; no performance measurement.
limitations: This establishes registration and loading, not dynamic fragment use in ordinary gameplay or original dynamic native execution. Global selector domain and Linux, USA and native Windows checks remain open.
